alt: Letter from DMHC requesting information for an IMR/Complaint.
summary: The Department of Managed Health Care sent a letter to Nicolas Hernandez requesting additional information for an Independent Medical Review/Complaint Form by August 20, 2026. Hernandez responded, confirming he still seeks review for access-to-care issues, despite the immediate treatment need being resolved. He also clarified that he disputes any characterization of failing to respond to outreach.

DEPARTMENT OF
Managed
Health Care
August 13, 2026

NICOLAS HERNANDEZ
CA 9

Gavin Newsom, Governor
State of California
Health and Human Services Agency
DEPARTMENT OF MANAGED HEALTH CARE
980 9th Street, Suite 500
Sacramento, CA 95814
Toll-Free: 1-888-466-2219 | Fax: 916-255-5241
Email: helpline@dmhc.ca.gov
www.DMHC.ca.gov

Patient: Nicolas Hernandez
DMHC#: 23
Health Plan: Local Initiative Health Authority for L.A. County (L.A. Care Health Plan)

Dear Nicolas Hernandez:

Thank you for sending your Independent Medical Review (IMR)/Complaint Form to the
Department of Managed Health Care (Department).

You are receiving this letter because additional information is required to process your
request. Please refer to the “Requested Information Sheet" on Page 3 of this letter for the
specific information needed.

Please submit the requested information along with the Requested Information Sheet
(Page 3 of this letter) to the Department no later than August 20, 2026. Please note you
must include the Requested Information Sheet (Page 3) to ensure the information you
submit is attached to your case.

The quickest way to return this information to the Department is by sending it via email to
helpline@dmhc.ca.gov or by fax to 916-255-5241. If either of those two options are not
available to you, the requested information can be mailed to:

Department of Managed Health Care
Help Center
980 9th Street Suite 500
Sacramento CA 95814

If you are unable to respond with the requested information by August 20, 2026, your
complaint will be closed. You may use the enclosed IMR Application/Complaint Form to
request that a new case be opened. You may also file an online IMR Application/Complaint
Form at www.DMHC.ca.gov.

Protecting the Health Care Rights of More Than 30.2 Million Californians
Contact the DMHC Help Center at 1-888-466-2219 or www.DMHC.ca.gov

Nicolas Hernandez
Case # 23
August 13, 2026
Page 2

Sincerely,

M.B.

Standard Complaint Branch
Help Center
Department of Managed Health Care

Attachment(s)

Nicolas Hernandez
Case # 23
August 13, 2026
Page 3

REQUESTED INFORMATION SHEET

[ ] Please complete all sections of the enclosed IMR/Complaint Form.

[ ] Please complete and sign the Medical Release section on the enclosed
IMR/Complaint Form.

Note: An enrollee 18 years of age or older must sign the IMR/Complaint Form unless
legal documentation is provided showing that someone else has the authority
to act on the enrollee's behalf.

[ ] Please complete the highlighted section(s) of the enclosed Authorized Assistant
Form. If we do not receive a completed Authorized Assistant form, we can still
process your IMR/Complaint. However, we will only be able to share information
about the IMR/Complaint with you.

[ ] Please provide the specific medical treatment(s)/service(s), and/or medication(s) you
are requesting. Please see the highlighted section of the enclosed IMR/Complaint
Form.

[ ] Please provide a letter signed by your physician/provider certifying that an imminent
and serious threat to your health exists and your case should be expedited. Please
note that the letter must describe the imminent and serious threat that exists.

[ ] Please complete and return the enclosed Legal Representative for Deceased Patient
Form, along with copies of applicable documentation (i.e., death certificate and either
a will, trust, or a court order demonstrating you are the legal representative for the
deceased patient).

[X] Please provide the clarification:

Your health plan states they have made multiple outreach attempts, mailed an
unable to contact letter, and opened a Case Management episode, but have been
unable to reach you at 661-648-7301 due to a full voicemail mailbox and lack of
response. As a result, the provider cannot complete a risk assessment or implement
a stabilization plan.

1. Can you please confirm if you are still requesting the department's assistance?
2. Please contact your health plan so they may assist you with setting up an
appointment.

Yes. Please see attached signed Response to Requested Clarification.

RESPONSE TO REQUESTED CLARIFICATION
DMHC Case # 23
Patient: Nicolas Hernandez
Health Plan: L.A. Care Health Plan

To the Department of Managed Health Care:

I am responding to the Requested Information Sheet dated August 13, 2026.

Yes, I am still requesting the Department's review of my complaint.

On August 13, 2026, I attended the referred appointment at Bartz Altadonna
Community Health Center. During that appointment, a physician agreed to assume
management of my established benzodiazepine taper. A prescription for diazepam
was issued, and a follow-up appointment was scheduled.

As a result, I am no longer requesting immediate assistance locating a clinician to
manage the taper, because that specific treatment need has now been addressed.

However, I am still requesting that the Department review the delays and access-to-
care issues that occurred before treatment was finally established, including the
period during which I did not have an accepting clinician managing the taper.

I also wish to clarify that I do not agree with any characterization that I failed to
respond to outreach without context. I had multiple communications regarding my
care and appointment arrangements. I can provide supporting call records,
messages, or other documentation if the Department requires them.

Please update DMHC Case # 23 to reflect that the immediate treatment-access
issue was resolved on August 13, 2026, while my request for review of the preceding
access-to-care issues remains active.

Sincerely,

Nicolas Hernandez

Signature:

Date: 08/14/2026
